whyInvest.title: Why invest in Madhya Pradesh
whyInvest.intro: Madhya Pradesh sits in the centre of India. The points below describe the case for investment in plain language. Replace them with the approved investment narrative.

items.title: Central location
items.summary: The state sits on major north–south and east–west routes, which shortens travel to several large markets.
items.detail: Use this space for the approved note on location, catchment markets, and logistics time. Do not add unpublished travel-time claims.

items.title: Connectivity
items.summary: Road, rail, and air links connect Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, Jabalpur, and other cities to the rest of the country.
items.detail: Add approved facts on airports, freight corridors, and industrial corridors when the organising team publishes them.

items.title: Land bank
items.summary: The state maintains a process for identifying industrial land. Project teams can ask the helpdesk for current plots.
items.detail: Describe how an investor requests land, which department replies, and what documents are needed. Leave acreage figures blank until they are official.

items.title: Power
items.summary: Power supply for industry is handled through the state utilities. New projects can flag their load in the interest form.
items.detail: Add the approved process for a power connection and any published capacity notes. Do not invent megawatt figures.

items.title: Skilled workforce
items.summary: Universities, ITIs, and industrial towns across the state are a base for hiring. Training needs can be raised with the helpdesk.
items.detail: Replace this with the approved note on skills, institutions, and any published training programmes.

items.title: Investor-friendly policies
items.summary: Incentives and approvals are explained in the downloadable policy set. The interest form tells the team what support you need.
items.detail: Name the current industrial policy only after the legal text is confirmed, and link the signed PDF from Downloads.

sectors.title: Priority sectors
sectors.intro: Tell us which sectors your project touches. You can select more than one on the interest form.

items.title: Industry
items.detail: For plant, component, and industrial-cluster projects. Describe the product, capacity, and land need in the form.

items.title: Agriculture and food processing
items.detail: For grain, horticulture, dairy, and food units. Mention raw-material catchment if you already know it.

items.title: IT and electronics
items.summary: Software, IT services, electronics, and data centres.
items.detail: For technology centres, electronics assembly, and related services. Note power and talent needs in the form.

items.title: Tourism
items.detail: For hospitality and tourism assets. Heritage and forest locations may need extra clearances — flag this under support needed.

items.title: Renewable energy
items.summary: Solar, wind, and other clean-energy projects.
items.detail: For generation, storage, and component manufacturing. Land and evacuation should be described in the project note.

items.title: Mining
items.detail: For responsible mining and downstream processing. Auctions and clearances follow separate rules; the form only registers interest.

items.title: Textiles
items.summary: Fibre, fabric, apparel, and technical textiles.
items.detail: For spinning, weaving, processing, and garmenting. Mention water and effluent needs if they are material.

items.title: Pharma
items.summary: Formulations, bulk drugs, and medical products.
items.detail: For pharmaceutical and medical-product units. Environmental and drug approvals stay with the competent authorities.

items.title: Logistics
items.detail: For parks, warehouses, and freight services that support other industries in the state.

about.title: About the summit
paragraphs: MP Conclave GIS is the Global Investors Summit of Madhya Pradesh. It is a meeting place for companies, institutions, and departments of the state government.

This website explains the summit and collects investment interest. Filing the form does not by itself approve a project, allot land, or release an incentive. Those steps follow the relevant rules and a review by the investment team.
The organising line on the summit material names the Government of Madhya Pradesh and the MP Industrial Development Corporation Ltd.
Dates, venue details, figures, messages, and downloadable files on this website are editable from the admin panel. Replace every placeholder before the site is announced.

support.title: Investor support
support.intro: A short path from the first form to a working project, plus answers to common questions.
support.helpdeskNote: Quote your reference number in every email or call so the team can open the right file.

faqs.a: Open Submit Investment Interest, complete the four steps, and confirm your email and mobile with the one-time codes. You will receive a reference number on the confirmation page.

faqs.q: Is there a fee to file the form?
faqs.a: The interest form on this website has no fee. Fees charged by other departments, if any, are separate and will be told to you during review.

faqs.q: How will the team contact me?
faqs.a: On the official email and mobile number you verified. Keep both available until your proposal is closed.

faqs.q: Can I check the status later?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Check status and enter the reference number together with the email used on the form.

faqs.q: Can I change the proposal after sending it?
faqs.a: The form cannot be edited online after submission. Email the helpdesk with your reference number and the change you need.

faqs.q: What file types can I attach?
faqs.a: One PDF or DOCX file, up to 10 MB, such as a company profile or a project note. The file is checked before it is stored.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: This is a working draft for the organising team to review with its legal adviser before publication.

The interest form collects company details, a contact person’s name, designation, official email, and mobile number, the project description, and an optional document. Email addresses and mobile numbers are stored in encrypted form.
The information is used to review the investment interest, contact the person named on the form, and produce internal reports for the investment team. It is not sold.
A confirmation message is sent to the email and mobile number you verified. A notice is also sent to the investment team inbox configured for this website.

You may ask the helpdesk, quoting your reference number, what information is held and request a correction. Access inside the admin panel is limited by role, and admin actions are written to an audit log.
Replace this draft with the policy cleared by the competent authority before the site is announced.

terms.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: This is a working draft for the organising team to review with its legal adviser before publication.
The pages on this website give general information about MP Conclave GIS. They are not an offer of land, incentive, or approval.
You must give accurate information in the interest form and use an official email and mobile number that you can access. Filing the form does not create a right to a meeting, an MoU, or an allotment.
Do not upload a file you are not allowed to share. Files are scanned and may be rejected if they are not a valid PDF or DOCX within the size limit.
The organising team may update page text, dates, and documents without notice. The reference number is the record of your submission.
Replace this draft with the terms cleared by the competent authority before the site is announced.
